title: Custom API / Backend Service Database Access
summary: 研究 Supabase Edge Function 作為 trusted backend service 時的資料庫 access、operation authorization 與 transaction ownership。Phase A/B/C/D 全部完成 runtime verification：object privilege / RLS、Function EXECUTE、database-owned RPC transaction 與 backend-owned PostgreSQL transaction 均已取得 controlled evidence。研究支持依 Business Operation responsibility 選擇 Native Data API、RPC 或 Backend-owned transaction，並要求 production direct DB access 使用 least-privilege identity。
flow: Phase A VERIFIED: PostgreSQL object privilege / RLS access boundaries. Phase B VERIFIED: approved Function EXECUTE can be separated from direct table writes. Phase C VERIFIED: one RPC owns atomic database transaction while separate Data API operations do not share rollback. Phase D VERIFIED: Edge Function PostgreSQL client can own BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK through Transaction Pooler; production adoption requires restricted DB identity and connection governance. Core experiment complete; no Phase E.
